districtFact: Bellevue School District separates the grades 1-12 opening date from Kindergarten WA Kids and the first kindergarten day. BSD has a regular Wednesday early-release schedule; the Wednesday staff categories in its academic calendar explain how those afternoons are used rather than adding more early-release days. The calendar also identifies conference early releases, regular-school-day quarter endings, and emergency make-up dates that may change status after a closure.

about.title: About Bellevue School District
about.content: Bellevue School District serves students in Bellevue and nearby Eastside communities in King County, Washington. The district publishes an academic calendar that combines student attendance dates with staff professional learning and work schedules, so families need to distinguish a student closure or early release from an internal staff calendar entry.

about.title: A Calendar With Grade-Level Opening Dates
about.content: BSD does not bring every student group back on the same date. The calendar lists a first day for grades 1-12, a Kindergarten WA Kids window, and a later first kindergarten day. The 2026-2027 calendar also names a separate preschool opening date, while the district's live calendar identifies the kindergarten date as the opening for the Evergreen Transition Program as well.

about.title: Static PDFs and Live Calendar Updates
about.content: The printable PDF is a static copy. BSD's official calendar page says downloaded calendars will not reflect future changes and offers website calendar subscriptions for update notifications. Families should use the PDF for the approved year structure and the live district or school calendar for later changes and school-specific events.

planningTips.title: Bellevue School District Calendar Notes
content: Use the opening date for the student's grade or program. Grades 1-12, Kindergarten WA Kids, kindergarten, preschool, and the Evergreen Transition Program do not all share one first day.
Elementary students attend school on conference dates but are released early. Confirm the release time and transportation plan with the school.
Quarter and semester endings can be regular school days. The 2026-2027 PDF explicitly labels all three listed grading-period endings as regular school days.
Emergency make-up dates are conditional. Some dates stay non-school days unless BSD needs them after a closure; the PDF gives specific decision cutoffs for the October and March dates.

BSD has a regular Wednesday early-release schedule. The staff categories listed for individual Wednesdays describe how staff use those afternoons; they do not create additional student early-release days.
Subscribe to the official website calendar if you need automatic updates. A downloaded BSD PDF or MySchoolDates ICS file is a static snapshot.

districtFaqs.q: Do Bellevue kindergarten students start with grades 1-12?
districtFaqs.a: No. BSD lists a Kindergarten WA Kids window and a later first day of kindergarten. Use the opening date for the student's grade or program.

districtFaqs.q: Are Bellevue elementary conference days full no-school days?
districtFaqs.a: No. The district calendar labels them as elementary conference early-release days. Students attend on a shortened schedule, and families should confirm exact dismissal and transportation times with their school.

districtFaqs.q: Are quarter-ending dates school days in Bellevue?
districtFaqs.a: They can be. The 2026-2027 BSD calendar explicitly marks the first-quarter, semester, and third-quarter ending dates as regular school days.

districtFaqs.q: How do emergency make-up days work in Bellevue School District?
districtFaqs.a: BSD reserves several dates that can be used after closures. Some are initially non-school days and have decision cutoffs, while June dates may extend the year. Check district announcements before treating a conditional date as a school day.

districtFaqs.q: How do BSD Wednesday staff categories relate to early release?
districtFaqs.a: BSD has a regular Wednesday early-release schedule. The collaboration, professional-development, restricted, and transition categories in the academic calendar explain how staff use those afternoons; they do not create additional early-release days.

districtFaqs.q: Will a downloaded Bellevue school calendar update automatically?
districtFaqs.a: No. BSD says printable downloads are static copies. Use the subscription controls on the official district calendar page for update notifications, and continue checking the student's school calendar.
